content.overview: Section 17 lists documents that must be registered, including gifts of immovable property, non-testamentary instruments creating or extinguishing rights of Rs 100 or more in immovable property, and leases from year to year or for more than one year.
content.study: Compulsory registration is the gateway rule. Pair it with section 49 (effect of non-registration) and with TPA formalities such as sale and lease. An unregistered document caught by section 17 generally cannot affect the property or prove the transaction, subject to the section 49 proviso.
